hashConvention: SHA-256 of UTF-8 LF text and exact parsed Pester It command extents.

selectors.selector: performs no write or download in WhatIf with DownloadOnly=<DownloadOnly> Existing=<Existing>
selectors.protects: both download and install WhatIf modes suppress all mutation, with absent or existing destinations.
selectors.detects: premature directory creation, DownloadOnly bypass, network access, cache reads, or installer dispatch.
selectors.needs: private fixture registry and bytes; all four DownloadOnly/Existing case combinations are inert.

selectors.selector: downloads verified bytes normally without executing an installer
selectors.protects: normal DownloadOnly still produces a verified private file without launching or extracting it.
selectors.detects: a fix that blocks useful downloads, alters forwarding, or dispatches an installer.
selectors.needs: actual public/private maintained functions, private registry, inert web-response bytes "abc".

selectors.selector: rejects an unelevated install before creating a directory or downloading
selectors.protects: an unelevated caller cannot trigger any actual installation work.
selectors.detects: a warning-only elevation check that lets a web request or launch proceed.
selectors.needs: a fixture registry with a valid digest and mocked elevation/network/process.

selectors.selector: rejects an install with a <Kind> digest before touching the cache
selectors.protects: missing, non-hex, short, and newline-suffixed digests cannot authorize installation.
selectors.detects: any digest case that reaches download or installer dispatch.
selectors.needs: a private registry, inert cases, and mocked elevated identity and side effects.

selectors.selector: skips a <InstallerType> entry without elevation or a digest
selectors.protects: Windows Update and inbox entries remain read-only skip routes.
selectors.detects: querying install prerequisites, downloading, or dispatching for either skip type.
selectors.needs: fixture registry and mocked elevation/network/process for both installer types.

selectors.selector: fails closed when the actual returned installer path has different bytes
selectors.protects: the selected installer path is checked against the pin before dispatch.
selectors.detects: launch after the selected file's contents fail the final source check.
selectors.needs: inert private file, stubbed download return and mocked process launch.

selectors.selector: dispatches signed staged bytes and preserves the separate download cache
selectors.protects: a valid pinned executable can still reach the installer boundary.
selectors.detects: a guard that returns success or failure without ever dispatching approved bytes.
selectors.needs: inert fixture bytes, staged directory and mocked signer and process.

selectors.selector: extracts each signed ZIP install into a fresh protected directory and cleans it
selectors.protects: each archive-backed install dispatches entries from its own extraction directory.
selectors.detects: reuse of the legacy extraction directory or of a prior invocation's package tree.
selectors.needs: two runs per installer type, a private ZIP of inert text files and mocked process launch.

selectors.selector: refuses a caller registry outside the installation trust root
selectors.protects: an execution request reads only the administrator-controlled machine registry.
selectors.detects: a caller-owned registry substituting URL, digest and signer in one edit.
selectors.needs: copied inert registry and mocked admin, downloader and launcher.

selectors.selector: cleans its protected stage when <Boundary> fails
selectors.protects: signature or access rejection leaves no executable behind and never dispatches.
selectors.detects: continuing to execution after any failed custody check.
selectors.needs: inert package bytes and mocked contract violation.

selectors.selector: leaves INF archives available only for manual acquisition
selectors.protects: automatic install fails when its package format cannot be publisher-qualified.
selectors.detects: invoking pnputil on an arbitrary member of a ZIP.
selectors.needs: inert registry entry, no signature platform, drivers or network.

selectors.selector: accepts only the protected owner and ancestry for <Case>
selectors.protects: protected leaves cannot be replaced through a writable ancestor.
selectors.detects: leaf-only checks, trust for a caller-owned leaf, or granting delete-child to non-admins.
selectors.needs: Windows local fixture and synthetic security descriptors. No operating system ACL changes.
selectors.breadcrumb: Assert-DriverInstallTrustPath walks the path and inspects every raw allow ACE.

selectors.selector: requires both a valid signature and identical publisher fingerprint for <Case>
selectors.protects: only a valid signature from the certificate pinned in the machine registry passes.
selectors.detects: subject-only matching, ignoring the status, or allowing a different valid signer.
selectors.needs: Windows Authenticode command mocked with an inert three-byte DER stand-in.
selectors.breadcrumb: Assert-DriverInstallerSignature status and certificate SHA256 checks.
